text:
Maria: Quick follow-ups from today's all-hands on API / Console / Optimize timelines. Trying to make a single view PMs + Eng can use — a few concrete asks below.

Kevin: API streaming GA is still targeted for the week of 2024-05-12. Canary starts next week. Main blocker: extended model compatibility tests (long tail seqs). Will post canary invite tomorrow. :calendar:

Sophia: Console's new Route Configs UI is on track for beta in June. We still need to finalize the migration path for existing routes (esp for customers with many pinned versions).

Raj: Optimize (cost/perf toolkit) roadmap: basic profiling + quantization recommendations land late Q2 (late June). The prescriptive autosuggests for batching and quant profiles are slated for end of Q3. Early evaluation harness will be available to internal users before public beta.

Olivia: Quick Q — will any of these require breaking SDK changes for customers?

Kevin: No breaking SDK surface changes planned. We'll add optional params and a couple of helpers. Example usage: ```js
client.generate({model: 'redwood-v1', batching: {hint: 'aggressive'}})
```
All old calls should keep working.

Maria: Who will own the Console migration docs? Need an owner + a target date so we can notify partners.

Dave: I can own the docs. Draft by 2024-06-10, internal review by PMs on 2024-06-17. I’ll drop a PR to the docs repo when the draft is ready.

Sophia: Please include a migration toggle for Private/Dedicated customers — some will want staged opt-in. Add me to reviews for the toggle UX.

Raj: Note on Dedicated: Optimize prescriptive suggestions will be disabled by default until we have benchmarked latency/SLA numbers on reserved pools. We don't want autosuggests to push configs that violate tenant SLOs.

Olivia: Will pricing change for Optimize features (beta vs GA)?

Kevin: No pricing changes for the initial beta. We will, however, surface estimated cost savings per-customer in the Console dashboard as part of the feature.

Maria: Action items: 1) @Kevin post canary invite + quick compatibility checklist (by EOD tomorrow); 2) @Dave drop migration doc link (draft by 2024-06-10); 3) @Raj share detailed Q3 timeline for Optimize (by 2024-05-15). I’ll compile a single timeline doc and ping leads for sign-off.

Kevin: sgtm.

Dave: on it.

Raj: I’ll post the timeline and perf caveats in this thread.

AllhandsBot: Recording & slides uploaded — https://redwood.company/allhands/2024-05-02 :movie_camera:

Maria: Thanks everyone — looping in leads for follow-up. If you want a quick sync, DM me or reply here. :thumbsup:
